elevenlabsPrompt:
[intrigued] Squinting at that tiny battery icon trying to guess what's left?

[confident] Here's the fix. Turn on Battery Percentage.

[friendly] Open Settings, then Battery. Switch on Battery Percentage. The number sits right inside the icon.

[delighted] No more guessing. You always know exactly what's left.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
coverLine: Your iPhone hides the battery number
